To recap, there are five types of screensavers:
Idle Screen :
Displays the Sparki charging station with the correct phone number.
Costa Coffee :
Displays the Costa Coffee screensaver only.
Costa Coffee + CCV Not Working:
Sequence: Costa Coffee screensaver → 5s → “CCV isn't working” (FR) → 5s → “CCV isn't working” (NL)
Costa Coffee + CCV Not Working + Station Not Working
(Only 170001921) :
Sequence: Costa Coffee screensaver → 5s → “CCV isn't working” (FR) → 5s → “CCV isn't working” (NL) → 5s → “Charger isn't working” (FR) → 5s → “Charger isn't working” (NL)
CCV Not Working :
Sequence: “CCV isn't working” (FR) → 5s → “CCV isn't working” (NL)
Chargers not listed above do not have a screensaver.
